description: Time zero = receiver entry to a 20 ms maximum one-shot after a modeled 25 °C cold start. Slot start/width in µs. Oracle traces use a separate individual-wire electrical solve and explicit two-node integration with nominal material constants. Probe sample voltages and currents are synthesized by rounding to 12-bit ADC codes. Point estimate and upper interval come from the compiled target observer. Cooling is unpowered propagation. Currents use 18 µs setup and 8 µs blanking in the emulator; hardware timing and temperatures require measurement.
